LanguageData.TabFoodDesc: Tracks food supply: calculates how many days current nutrition will last based on the number of colonists and their hunger rate.
LanguageData.TabMedicineDesc: Counts available medicine and untended injuries. Alerts when medicine runs low.
LanguageData.TabAnimalsDesc: Detects starving animals by checking for the Malnutrition hediff or zero food level.
LanguageData.TabDoctorDesc: Warns when all doctors (Medicine priority enabled) are downed or incapacitated.
LanguageData.TabRepairDesc: Checks all damaged buildings and shows which ones can't be repaired due to missing resources.
LanguageData.TabImmunityDesc: Monitors colonists whose infection severity is ahead of their immunity progress.
LanguageData.TabOtherDesc: General settings and welcome message preferences.
LanguageData.AlertFoodDaysDesc: Nutrition: {1} | Pawns: {2}\nFood supply will last approx. {0} days.
LanguageData.AlertFoodMealsDesc: Meals: {1} | Pawns: {2}\nFood supply will last approx. {0} days.
LanguageData.ShowWelcomeMessageTip: Show a one-time welcome message when starting a new colony.
LanguageData.WelcomeText:
Welcome to Colony Analytics!

This mod adds useful alerts to your notification panel:

• Food will last X days — tracks nutrition supply
• Medicine for X treatments — shows available medicine
• Starving animals — alerts if animals lack food
• Doctor unconscious — warns when no doctor is available
• No repair resources — shows missing materials for repairs
• Immunity lagging — warns if infection outpaces immunity

All alerts can be configured in:
Menu → Options → Mod Settings → Colony Analytics
